_doc: PINNED RETRACTION -- consolidated cells for quarters where the company filed NO consolidated result at all. Distinct from copied_con_purge.json, which nulls con cells that EXACTLY EQUAL their standalone twin (the byte-copy signature, runbook 85a-ter). These cells DIFFER from standalone and therefore survived that purge -- but 'differs' only proves 'not a byte copy', it never proves 'a consolidated table exists'. Where the exchange record shows no consolidated filing, ANY con value is fabricated regardless of whether it differs. Entries carry held=<reason>, so verify_fills_live.py's resurrection check (runbook 85b) asserts these cells stay ABSENT and reports them if an applier refills them. Apply with scripts/apply_con_nofile_retractions.py (idempotent, re-runnable).
